variables.title: Variables & Constants
variables.notes: Modern JS favors 'const' for everything that won't be reassigned, and 'let' otherwise. 'var' is mostly obsolete.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: JavaScript has one 'number' type for both ints and floats. Arrays and functions are underlyingly objects.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Always use '===' and '!==' to avoid unexpected type coercion that occurs with '=='.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Braces are optional for single-line blocks, but strictly recommended for readability and safety.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Use 'for...of' for iterating over arrays and iterables, and 'for...in' for object properties.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: The 'do...while' loop guarantees the body executes once before checking the condition.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Arrow functions are preferred for callbacks because they don't bind their own 'this' context.

arrays.title: Arrays / Lists
arrays.notes: Modern JS leans heavily on functional array methods (map, filter, reduce) rather than manual loops.

maps.title: Maps / Dictionaries
maps.notes: Objects are typically used for static key-value pairs; Maps are better when keys are dynamic or non-strings.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: JavaScript supports try/catch/finally. Any value can be thrown, but it's best practice to throw Error objects.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: JavaScript provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: JavaScript supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: JavaScript provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: JavaScript converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: JavaScript represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: JavaScript formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: JavaScript branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: JavaScript defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: JavaScript iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: JavaScript organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: JavaScript stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: JavaScript groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: JavaScript tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: JavaScript organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
